caption: A flag flutters on a pole in the sun, and its shadow flutters on the wall behind it.

sa.check: A flag flutters on a pole in the sun.
Its shadow flutters on the wall behind it.
The shadow moves in time with the cloth.
The shadow stops when the flag hangs still.

pc.expect: The shadow moves in time with the cloth and stops when the flag hangs still.
pc.fail: It is still while the flag flutters; or it flutters while the flag hangs still; or it moves out of time.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the flag's outline, rippling as the flag ripples.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or a rigid rectangle while the flag ripples; or it splits.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the wall away from the sun, joined to the pole's shadow.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or detached from the pole's shadow; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The flag moves only with the wind, and the shadow only with the flag.
pc.fail: The flag whips in still air; or the shadow moves before the flag; or the shadow drifts along the wall by itself.

pc.expect: One flag, one pole and one shadow.
pc.fail: A second flag or shadow appears; or the flag vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the flag passes through the pole.

pc.expect: The flag's colours and the wall stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The flag changes colours; or the shadow turns coloured; or the wall changes.
